**Waiting for VM service to start**

I need to wait for the VM service to start up. In the meantime, I can tail the log for “Dart VM Service” to keep an eye on things. It might be a good idea to use a bash sleep command for a few seconds and then grep the logs for any updates. This way, I’ll stay informed without constantly checking. Fingers crossed it starts up smoothly!
